name: Littlestone Dimension of Majority-Query Separation Products
proof: Littlestone dimension is additive on Cartesian products over disjoint coordinate blocks: after a coordinate query in one factor, both child version spaces remain products, and the standard rank recurrence gives the sum of the factor ranks by induction. Each C_maj factor has rank 2, so the t-fold product has rank 2t.
references: Direct recurrence argument; checked for one and two factors by sync/verify_majority_gap_products.py.
